 Hands\\-on experience in Scrum/Agile teams, contributing beyond test execution by influencing acceptance criteria, improving testability, and embedding quality throughout the SDLC.

 Skilled in testing SaaS/iPaaS and other cloud\\-based systems across Windows and Linux environments, including containerized and orchestrated deployments (Docker, Kubernetes). Strong understanding of distributed system architectures and the quality challenges they introduce — including service dependencies, scalability, and fault tolerance.

 Strong experience validating REST/SOAP APIs, working with JSON/XML payloads, and testing integrations with databases, CRM/ERP systems, and external services.

 Experience leveraging AI tools to improve test generation, code quality, analysis, or productivity, with genuine curiosity to keep exploring what's possible.

* Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
* Join a mission\\-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business\\-critical processes.
